text.zone.town: Sharpened stakes and damp wool smoke guard the last market town before the fens. Reeve Marlow pays for every road you reopen.
text.zone.m01-outskirts: Fields the militia no longer patrols. Raider packs probe the palisade from the broken hedgerows.
text.zone.m01-willows: Drooping willows hide the plank paths. Whatever moves in the shallows has learned that carts come this way.
text.zone.m01-ford: Cold river water swirls around sunken wagon axles where the border watch fell. The crossing decides who feeds the town.
text.zone.m01-granary: Scorched beams and spilled grain. The horde burned what it could not carry, and some of it still lingers.
text.zone.m01-bluff: Open granite above the river. Whoever holds the ridge sees every fire on the border.
text.zone.m01-warcamp: Hide tents and sharpened logs ring the standard of Chieftain Grok'tar, who drove the horde across the river.
text.zone.m02: Black water and swaying reeds swallow every path. Raiders burned the outposts here, and their archers still hold the dry ridge.
text.zone.m03: A crumbling border fortress pierced by four ruined gates. Blood-crazed packs gather around it at twilight.
text.zone.m04: Knee-deep black water laps against defaced saints. Mordred the Ashen keeps his blood-guard in the flooded nave.
text.zone.m05: Slate cliffs funnel every footstep beneath iron-caged lamps. The Ravine Warden holds the upper narrows.
text.zone.m06: Three raider storehouses under the Greywood canopy feed every patrol on the border road. Quartermaster Tarn counts the spoils.
text.zone.m07: A granite fang splits the highland road into two narrow defiles, each with a cold signal cairn above it.
text.zone.m08: Old granite arches carry the only heavy road across the swollen Alder. Raider columns mass on the far bank.
text.zone.m09: Tusk gouges and snapped spears mark the moor. Krag Ironhide rallies broken bands inside the north-eastern quarry.
text.zone.m10: Torchlit brick galleries run beneath the canyon ridge. Cultists and stone sentinels hold the old vaults.
text.zone.m11: Dusk over the road home. Siege Commander Velen waits beyond the southern gatehouse of Ashbrook.
text.title: Act I — The Border
text.body: One continuous march from Thornwick to Ashbrook. Roads link every zone; waypoints let you return.
text.msg.1: Step within the palisades, Commander. The mud of the outer roads clings heavy to your boots. Before you lies Thornwick: the tavern on the left for mercenary blades and whispers, the armory shop in the center for tempered steel, and the academy on the right for runic incantations. Take these silver crowns from the garrison ledger to equip your cohort.
text.win: The roads around Thornwick are safe again.
text.npc.reeve: Raiders choke every mountain pass, and half the garrison is either shivering with marsh fever or drinking away their back pay. Take the tavern contracts on the board, Commander—Thornwick still pays in silver, even if the coins are tarnished by blood.
text.npc.miller: Gnolls broke into the mill at midnight, dragging two sacks of coarse flour into the marsh. If you march eastward toward the border ford, keep your shield tilted high—their barbed horn-bows punch straight through boiled leather.
text.npc.gate_n1: North Gate Watchman: Keep your steel dry on the Mint Road.
text.npc.gate_n2: North Gate Pikeman: Hound packs prowl past the third milestone.
text.npc.gate_e1: East Gate Watchman: The Sunken Ford bridge holds, barely.
text.npc.gate_e2: East Gate Lookout: Smoke rises from the alder reeds at dusk.
text.npc.tanner: Market Tanner: Boiled hides keep peat-leeches off your shins.
text.npc.cooper: Cooper Apprentice: Casks for salt pork and lantern oil, stacked fresh.
text.npc.scribe: Academy Scribe: High Arcanist Vaelen inspects every vitrified shard.
text.npc.bellows: Smithy Bellows-Boy: Master Kaelen keeps the coals white-hot till midnight.
text.npc.carter: Granary Carter: Axle grease costs less than a broken wain in the mud.
text.npc.grave: Orlen the Grave-Tender: Keep the tallow lit by the parish stones.
text.npc.hound: Stable Hound: *Low bark, ears perked toward the east palisade.*
text.npc.fisher: Dockside Fisher: Weir-pikes bite near the old pilings after rain.
text.npc.garrick: Sergeant-at-Arms Garrick: The militia has not been paid and the road is not held. If you want work, I have it.
text.npc.marta: Widow Marta: The sickhouse is full and my shelves are empty. Fetch me what the marsh grows.
text.npc.hobb: Master Hobb: Iron on credit and no tallies to show for it. Help me get what I am owed.
text.npc.fenwick: Old Fenwick: The river tells me things, Commander. Some of them are worth silver.
